entities.title: Tests
entities.summary: The node:test suites for the burrows, the game and the Worker.
entities.purpose: Checks the game without a browser: build.mjs --test bundles each *.test.ts into dist-test/, and npm test runs them after the type-check. maze.test.ts digs 300 burrows; game.test.ts plays the engine step by step; worker.test.ts calls the Worker's handler with stand-ins for the login service and the static assets.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in the verification files of the folders it checks: src/engine and worker.
Nothing here runs the page, the drawing, the controls or the sound (games/lundey/src/.dev/verification.json).
